meta.name: Obsession
meta.description: A respected London surgeon's affair with his son's fiancée turns into an erotic infatuation that threatens to change their lives forever.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: William and Ingrid look forward to meeting Jay's new girlfriend, Anna. But before their formal introduction, William and Anna lock eyes — and sparks fly.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As their passion intensifies, Anna establishes rules for William to follow, only for his resolve to be tested when she goes to Paris with Jay.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Feeling on edge after receiving mysterious text messages during Anna and Jay’s engagement party, William soon slips up. Sally makes a confession.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The walls begin to close in on William and Anna before a tragic event changes everything. Anna's mother admits to a shocking secret about the past.
